checks.note: Both agent_type_id and agent_instance_id are written on every record (audit.py:103-104, enforced non-empty at audit.py:86-88), and the type id is recomputable from release/manifest.yaml (identity.py:63). Nothing in the repo stores manifests keyed by that id, so the lookup store is outside this repo.

The single agent type maps to a team, and operational_owner defaults to that same team via env. There is no on-call rotation, named current operator or CODEOWNERS file in the repo, so any on-call mapping would be in an outside catalog.

checks.quote:
AND (scope = 'fleet' OR scope = $1)
    scope    text PRIMARY KEY,           -- 'fleet' or 'tenant:<business_unit>'
checks.note: The only containment control is the halt flag, scoped to the whole fleet or one tenant. There is no per-instance or per-agent-type halt or revoke. The check also runs only when a run starts (README:58), so it cannot stop a live instance. The tenant scope stops every agent instance in that business unit, not the one suspicious instance or type.

violates: contain the right instance or agent type
note: Containment is limited to fleet-wide or tenant-wide halt flags checked at run start, so a single instance or agent type cannot be contained; manifest-store lookup and on-call ownership are not in the repo.
